keywordSearch.title: Keyword search
keywordSearch.effects: PostgreSQL coverage remains mandatory. Optional Elasticsearch reads supplement results. Indexing sends future processed attachments and explicit reindex requests; enabling does not backfill existing files.
keywordSearch.retention: Switching preserves old index ownership. Cleanup uses its original active connection; revocation blocks it. An in-flight request may already have reached the server.
keywordSearch.failure: Request failed or settings changed. Reload settings and retry.
keywordSearch.preflightLimits: Preflight checks connectivity and privileges without writing a document. It does not prove deployed indexing, end-to-end search, or tenant isolation.
keywordSearch.referencesLimit: Showing the newest 100 instance references. Enter another instance SecretRef directly.
keywordSearch.preflightPassed: Connection checks passed. Document indexing has not been verified.
keywordSearch.preflightFailed: Connection checks did not pass. Review the diagnostic result and retry.
keywordSearch.versionUnverified: Server version has not been confirmed.

Only effects on cards you can currently: Only effects on cards you can currently read are shown.
Notify the author when someone else ente: Notify the author when someone else enters this stage
Compaction threshold counts only new unc: New uncompressed comment bodies count toward this limit. Existing summaries and movement events are excluded.
Ask to move descendants when a root card: Ask to move descendants when a root card enters this stage
No active configured card event hook: No active configured card event hook

Bot options unavailable. Saved bindings: Bot options unavailable. Saved bindings are preserved.
Dispatch accepted; see bot logs for exec: Dispatch accepted; see bot logs for execution details.
Compaction triggers when any enabled thr: Compaction triggers when any enabled threshold is reached. Counts include only new uncompressed active comments. Zero disables comment and turn thresholds.
A conversation turn is a consecutive run: A conversation turn is a consecutive run of comments by the same actor in creation order. Activity events and previous summaries do not count.
Account summary scope: Counts exclude your account and match search, administrator, provider and date filters across all account statuses.
User list failed: Unable to load users. Refresh to retry.
User details failed: Unable to load this user. Check your access and refresh to retry.
Configured permissions description: Stored account roles. Access to each board or resource is evaluated separately by the server.
Group changed review current state: This group changed. Review the current revision and submit again. Your input has been preserved.
Group write denied: Group change denied. Review your permissions and the current group source.
Invalid group input: Enter a valid group name or member selection.
Group write failed: Could not save the group change. Try again.
Confirm group destructive change: Confirm this destructive change. It cannot be undone.
Compaction thresholds use OR. Remove a t: Compaction thresholds use OR. Remove a threshold to disable it; at least one positive threshold is required. Unrelated conditions belong in a separate rule.
Uses the currently configured dedicated: Uses the currently configured dedicated compactor profile and an explicit current board grant. Linking a rule grants no permission.
Native bot conditions, scope, active sta: Native bot conditions, scope, active state and frozen state remain independent eligibility checks. Interval actions also require an available card schedule.
Each rule requires a name, an action and: Each rule requires a name, an action and valid conditions. Compaction requires at least one positive OR threshold.
Configuration captured when this run was: Configuration captured when this run was admitted. Later rule edits do not change this evidence.
Installation request consent help: Installation approval does not enable apps or grant board permissions. Board consent and connections require separate setup.
Installation request uncertain: Request result uncertain. Refresh to read the saved result before retrying.

Invalid sign-in range: Enter valid, unambiguous local times with the start before the end.
Business activity range help: Local time inputs are converted to UTC. Start is included; end is excluded. This range filters business changes independently of sign-in.
Invalid business activity range: Enter valid, unambiguous local times with the start before the end.
Effective card read description: Search at least two characters and select a readable card to inspect current card.read access in this session channel. Whisper content remains separately restricted.
Card search failed: Unable to search readable cards. Change the search text to retry.
Card read denied reason: Current board read access, card visibility or private ownership does not permit this user to read this card.

mail.testMessageHelp: Each explicit action sends one message. Sending is never automatic.
mail.singleRecipient: Enter one bare email address without a display name or address list.
mail.invalidRecipient: One valid email address is required. No automatic retry was made.
mail.send_accepted: SMTP server accepted the message. Inbox delivery is not confirmed.
mail.send_failed: SMTP submission failed. Review the error before another explicit send.
mail.send_unknown: Outcome unknown. The message may have been sent. Do not retry automatically; check before sending again.
mail.inboxUnverified: Inbox delivery is unverified; no inbox receipt is available.
mail.historyCoverage: Recorded SMTP attempts after migration include direct signup, recovery, invitation, template and test messages. Earlier direct sends are unavailable; legacy outboxes are not backfilled.
mail.noRecordedAttempts: No associated SMTP attempts recorded. Earlier sends and retries remain unknown.
mail.oneRecordedAttempt: One associated SMTP attempt recorded. No additional attempt is recorded; earlier sends and retry intent remain unknown.
mail.multipleRecordedAttempts: Multiple associated SMTP attempts recorded. Original retry intent and earlier sends remain unknown.
mail.retryUnknown: No shared outbox identity. Related attempts and retry history are unknown.
mail.historyUnknown: Historical subjects and retry history for legacy rows are not recorded. Raw SMTP replies and inbox receipts are unavailable. Attempt and legacy views are separate; do not add their counts.
mail.dateHelp: UTC midnight boundaries: start inclusive, end exclusive. Load history applies filters; load more uses the last applied filters.
mail.dateRangeError: End date must be later than start date.
mail.historyError: History could not be loaded. Use an explicit load action to try again.
mail.detailMissing: This delivery record is no longer available.
mail.noHistory: No records match the applied filters within the covered outboxes.
mail.historyLimit: Showing at most 250 records. Narrow the date or status filters.
mail.evidence_claimed: Worker claimed the record; SMTP outcome unverified
mail.worker_outcome_unknown: Worker ended without recording an SMTP outcome.
mail.title: Mail
mail.environment: Effective SMTP configuration is managed through the environment. Credential values are never displayed.
mail.noDelivery: This checks DNS, TCP, TLS and authentication only. No message is sent. SMTP message submission and inbox delivery have not been checked.
mail.loadError: Could not load SMTP configuration. Retry to load it again.
mail.diagnoseError: Could not run the connection check. Try again.
mail.permissionError: Access expired or was denied. Mail configuration and diagnostics have been cleared.
mail.subject: Subject (native label)
mail.attemptTimeout: SMTP attempt timed out; outcome is unknown.
